question: Mukteshwara Temple is a 10th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Shiva, located in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mukteshwara Temple

 
 
• Located in **Bhubaneswar **is the confluence of the Godavari and Pranahita rivers,** in Odisha.**
 
• The significant feature is the presence of two Shiva Lingas on a single pedestal.
 
• Lord Shiva and Lord Yama (Mukteshwara) temples are present.
 
• The main attraction is the statue of fish.
